globFile.description: List or inspect files and directories within the project workspace.
when_to_use: You need to understand project structure quickly
You want to confirm a file was created or moved
You’re looking for candidate locations for a feature
examples: Show server/ and app/ directories if present

grepFile.description: Search project files for a string or regex pattern to locate code or references.
when_to_use: You know a symbol, function, or string to find
You need to trace a call site or definition
You want to find all usages before an edit

parameters.pattern: Exact string or regex (escape special chars as needed)
parameters.path: Optional path to narrow the search
parameters.multiline: Set true only for cross-line patterns

cautions: Prefer precise patterns to avoid noisy matches
Use path/glob to reduce search scope for speed

editFile.description: Apply minimal, targeted edits in a single file with clean diffs.
when_to_use: Fixes that don’t require touching multiple files
best_practices: Summarize what changed and why after editing
examples: Rename a prop and update its type

multi_fileEdit.description: Apply coordinated edits across multiple files for scaffolds or refactors.
when_to_use: A feature spans routes, components, and tests
Consistent renames or API updates across files
best_practices: Group related changes into a single operation
Prefer incremental steps with clear summaries
examples: Add Stripe: server route, client button, env var
Migrate fetch wrapper and update all callers

webSearch.description: Search for technical references, official docs, examples, or recent changes.
when_to_use: Library/framework usage is unclear or recently changed
You need authoritative docs or minimal examples
examples: Next.js app router middleware auth patterns
cautions: Prefer primary sources and stable APIs
